exposure: urinary tract infection during antenatal care
Urinary tract infection (UTI) screening during antenatal care
outcome: Frequency of UTI at the time of cesarean delivery
cohort: 159 women undergoing cesarean delivery at term pregnancy
finding: The frequency of bacteriuria at the time of cesarean delivery decreases considerably after regular antenatal UTI screening with urine dipstick, microscopic urinalysis, and counseling of pregnant women regarding UTIs.
